scope.decision_question: Can end-of-tournament Spanish-Wikipedia revisions provide broad player appearances/minutes/statistics for Primera Division 2016?

independiente.note: Values appear populated, but scope cannot be certified as Primera short-tournament-only from the table itself.

newells_old_boys.note: PJ and goals remained zero across the roster near tournament end, so the table was not maintained as a reliable performance source.

consequences: Retain Wikipedia historical revisions as a viable roster_snapshot source for Argentina 2016.
Do not promote end-of-tournament Wikipedia counters as league-season appearances/minutes.
Continue searching for an independent appearance/minute source with explicit tournament scope.
non_claims: No PostgreSQL or production data was written.
The populated Independiente PJ counters were not assumed to be Primera-only.
